capabilities: Sync selected folders of Markdown notes to a Day & Age account on a schedule
Pair the vault with the account using a one-time pairing code
Choose folders, subfolders, and root-level notes to include in the sync
Save conflicted local edits to timestamped .dayage-conflict files
Report skipped oversized notes and compare scanned versus cloud note counts
disambiguation: The AI chat itself runs in the Day & Age app, not in Obsidian; the plugin only syncs notes and pairs the vault.
extras: Workspace access is invite-only; notes over 100,000 characters are skipped; sync runs on open, on foreground return, on reconnect, and every three minutes; the README states iOS retesting is still needed and the Android checklist remains untested.
problem: Obsidian notes stay local, so there is no built-in way to make selected vault folders available to an outside AI chat service.

relations.evidence: only relevant excerpts may be sent to Anthropic to answer that request

requires.name: Day & Age app (creates the pairing code)

summary: Folder-scoped sync of Markdown notes to a Day & Age AI Gurus account so the service's AI chat can retrieve note excerpts.
